name: @zungun/zep-cf-canary
description: Stateless Cloudflare edge canary for the audited Zungun ZEP core delivery 006.

scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.fuzz: npm run clean && npm run build && node tools/fuzz-canary.mjs && node tools/fuzz-test-codec.mjs
scripts.verify:available: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run fuzz && npm run verify:config
scripts.dry-run: rm -rf dist-worker .wrangler && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker --metafile dist-worker/bundle-meta.json
scripts.verify: npm run verify:available && npm run wrangler:types && npm run dry-run
